param.name: input_type_selector
param.label: Choose the type of input data

param.name: chunk_size
param.label: Output Zarr column chunk size. Defaults to 10.

param.name: batch_processing
param.label: Batch processing
param.help: If the expression matrix will be written to Zarr incrementally. Use to avoid loading the whole AnnData into memory. Defaults to False.

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Batch size
param.help: The amount of rows (if matrix is in CSR format) or columns (if matrix is dense or in CSC format) of the expression matrix to process at a time when batch processing. Defaults to 10000.

param.name: load_clusters
param.label: Include cluster files
param.help: If cluster files should be included in the AnnData object. Defaults to True.

param.name: load_embeddings
param.label: Include embeddings
param.help: If embedding coordinates files should be included in the AnnData object. Defaults to True.

param.name: load_raw
param.label: Use raw matrix count file
param.help: If the raw matrix count file should be loaded instead of the filtered matrix. Defaults to False.

param.name: save_h5ad
param.label: Save h5ad file
param.help: If the AnnData object should also be written to an h5ad file. Defaults to False.

param.name: spatial_as_pixel
param.label: Convert spatial coordinates to pixels
param.help: Boolean indicating whether spatial coordinates should be converted to pixels. Defaults to True.

param.name: save_h5ad
param.label: Save h5ad file
param.help: If the AnnData object should also be written to an h5ad file. Defaults to False.

param.name: filter_prefix
param.label: Filter prefix
param.help: Prefix to filter out of the data. Defaults to `Blank-`

param.name: save_h5ad
param.label: Save h5ad file
param.help: If the AnnData object should also be written to an h5ad file. Defaults to False.

param.name: prefix
param.label: Enter a prefix for the output file(s)

data.name: output_h5ad
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: h5ad output
data.filter: 'h5ad' not in input_type['input_type_selector'] and 'molecules' not in input_type['input_type_selector'] and input_type['save_h5ad']

data.name: output_zarr
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: compressed zarr output
data.filter: input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'h5ad' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'spaceranger' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'xenium' or input_type['input_type_selector'] == 'merscope'
